expectations.text: Names time to first call (TTFC) as the governing metric for this work and sets an explicit target figure for Ledgerwell.
expectations.evidence: '## TTFC target' sets 'M1: ... median under 15 minutes' and 'M2: ... median under 60 minutes'.

expectations.text: Anchors that target to the API's complexity class - OAuth plus webhooks - landing near an hour rather than a sub-15-minute figure.
expectations.evidence: 'Complexity class: OAuth2 plus webhooks. The skill's practitioner anchor is under one hour for this class.'

expectations.text: States that no universal TTFC benchmark exists, instead of presenting one number as an industry standard.
expectations.evidence: 'There is no universal benchmark.'

expectations.text: Recommends instrumenting TTFC in increments, at minimum landing-to-signup and signup-to-first-call, rather than as a single end-to-end number.
expectations.evidence: Step 1 lists events for landing, signup, email verified, credential created, token obtained, first 2xx call and webhook steps.

expectations.text: States that the funnel data, once instrumented, outranks the default ordering of fixes: whichever stage stalls gets its fix promoted.
expectations.evidence: 'The largest drop-off gets fix priority, even where it differs from my ordering below. Funnel data outranks the default ranking.'

expectations.text: Recognizes that docs, catalog and pricing are already ungated, so the ungated-exploration rung is already satisfied and the work starts further up the ladder.
expectations.evidence: 'Docs, catalog and pricing are already public... ungated exploration, is done, so you start one rung up.'

expectations.text: Recommends shipping an importable, forkable, ready-to-run collection of working example calls.
expectations.evidence: 'Ship a forkable Postman-style collection' with a token pre-request script.

expectations.text: Recommends auto-provisioned sandbox keys injected into quickstart snippets and try-it calls as the fix for a stall sitting between signup and first call.
expectations.evidence: Step 2: 'Create a sandbox OAuth client at signup... Inject the client_id and secret into every quickstart snippet and into the try-it console.'

expectations.text: Explicitly demotes or defers role-and-use-case personalized onboarding intake, tying that to the six-week deadline and the part-time engineering capacity.
expectations.evidence: 'Personalized onboarding. Highest effort, and the skill says a hard deadline demotes it.' The weekly plan shows part-time engineers.

expectations.text: Any first-call acceleration figure attributed to a ready-to-run collection is expressed as a ratio of roughly 1.7x, labeled vendor-reported, with no baseline minute count carried over.
expectations.evidence: 'Postman reports about 1.7x faster first calls... That is a vendor number: keep the ratio, don't copy the minutes.'

expectations.text: Warns that TTFC is a leading indicator only, and names downstream activation or retention as a trend to watch alongside it.
expectations.evidence: 'A first call isn't an activated integrator, so track repeat calls and webhook receipt'; step 6 reports the 7-day activation rate; 'I'd frame the result as a trend'.
